topic.title: Quadratic Equations
topic.subject: Mathematics
topic.description: Master quadratic equations through standard form identification, factorization by splitting the middle term, Sridharacharya quadratic formula, discriminant nature of roots, and real-world mathematical modeling.

skills.name: Identify Quadratic Equations in Standard Form
skills.description: Expand algebraic expressions to check if they reduce to ax^2+bx+c=0 with a != 0.

skills.name: Solve by Splitting the Middle Term
skills.description: Find integers p, q such that p+q=b and pq=ac to factorise quadratic trinomials.

skills.name: Substitute Roots & Determine Unknown Parameters (k)
skills.description: Use root definitions to find unknown coefficients.

skills.name: Calculate Discriminant D = b^2 - 4ac
skills.description: Correctly compute the discriminant from quadratic coefficients.

skills.name: Apply Quadratic Formula to Find Roots
skills.description: Apply x = (-b +- sqrt(D))/2a, including irrational/surd roots.

skills.name: Transform Fractional & Algebraic Equations to Quadratics
skills.description: Simplify complex fractions into standard form.

skills.name: Classify Roots from Discriminant Sign
skills.description: Categorise roots as real & distinct (D>0), real & equal (D=0), or no real roots (D<0).

skills.name: Solve Parameter 'k' for Equal/Real Roots
skills.description: Set D = 0 or D >= 0 to solve equations/inequalities for k.

skills.name: Model Numbers and Geometric Dimensions
skills.description: Translate consecutive integer, perimeter, and area word problems into quadratic models.

skills.name: Model Uniform Motion (Speed, Distance, Time) & Upstream/Downstream
skills.description: Set up time-difference equations D/x - D/(x+k) = Delta t.

skills.name: Model Work and Water Tap Rates
Contextual Root Validation & Unit Formatting
skills.description: Reject inadmissible negative roots for physical quantities (time, length, age, speed).

prerequisite_check.question: If speed is $x$ and distance is 360, time taken is:

core_concepts: **1. General Strategy:** Identify the unknown, denote by $x$, form the quadratic equation, solve, and check if the answer makes physical sense (e.g., speed/length/age cannot be negative).
- **Numbers:** Two numbers sum $S$, product $P \Rightarrow S-x, x$.
- **Speed/Time:** Difference in time usually leads to $D/x - D/(x+speed) = \Delta t$.

callout_boxes.html: For Case-Based questions, always provide the final answer with units (km/h, years, etc.).

guided_and_independent.solution: $150/x - 150/(x+5)=1 \Rightarrow x^2+5x-750=0 \Rightarrow (x+30)(x-25)=0 \Rightarrow x=25 ... wait \Rightarrow y=x+5$ calculation check. $150 \times 5 / x(x+5)=1 \Rightarrow x^2+5x-750=0 \Rightarrow (x+30)(x-25)=0 \Rightarrow x=25$.
guided_and_independent.migration_review: Source correctIndex is 1 (option: "30"), but source solution notes x=25 is the original speed while x+5=30 is the increased speed. Preserved original source option and index.
